findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following nonfood-contact surfaces in need of cleaning:
(i) the undersides of the soda dispensers.
(ii) the bottom of the short cooler.
The PIC was informed and will have staff clean these areas more frequently to prevent an accumulation of soil residues.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Inspector noted some shelves in the back by the 3 part sink have some accumulated soil. Clean metal shelving units to eliminate dust and debris. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Inspector observed the can opener to be soiled. Clean the can opener regularly to preclude the accumulation of soil. Can opener was discarded. The violation is considered corrected.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The door jamb of the back door is separating from the building. The door was damaged during the tornado in June of 2023. The door should be repaired as daylight is visible around the top of the door jamb.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

Observed no signed employee health reporting agreements. Ensure staff reads and signs document. Ensure staff is given document as a part of onboarding. Keep in public health folder/binder. If Taco John’s new employee paperwork includes an employee health reporting agreement section, provide copy of this paperwork from corporate. Need verification of a sick policy in place. Inspector will follow-up on 11/14/22.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Observed sani bucket to be low - 100 ppm quaternary ammonium. Facility has test strips to check concentration (200-400 ppm). Ensure sani buckets are frequently changed in order to maintain concentration (4-6 hours max). Discussed with employees and PIC. PIC remade bucket from 3 compartment sink - 400 ppm. COS.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed space between the mop sink and the floor - caulk so smooth and easily cleanable, non-absorbent. Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before next routine inspection. This is a repeat violation since the pre-opening inspection on 9/30/22.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

Observed no food handler’s licenses for any employees. Ensure food handler’s obtain a license within 30 days of employment. Keep copies in public health folder/binder. Discussed with PIC.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-304.11: If necessary to keep rooms free of excessive heat, steam, condensation, vapors, obnoxious odors, smoke, and fumes, mechanical ventilation of sufficient capacity shall be provided.

Observed hood system to not be properly ventilating. Smoke visible/smell slightly in customer dining area. Call certified service repair in HVAC - repair or diagnose and order parts. 7-day follow-up. Provide proof of service with service inspection notes/order reports. Inspector will follow-up on 10/26/22. CaptiveAire - hood system installation company.
